guard_root_cause.metadata: The previous AST visitor merged ownership and accent values from unrelated main elements, so split route roots could satisfy each check independently.
guard_root_cause.prelude: The previous visitor accepted any data-page-prelude marker in the file, including a marker outside the route-root subtree.

contract_updates.update: Each JSX main is validated as an individual route root; ownership and accent must match on that same root, and prelude evidence is resolved only from the root subtree or locally referenced JSX bindings. Self-test covers missing, malformed, split-main, unrelated-prelude, and same-root cases.
Personal ordinary legacy routes may intentionally redirect to /workspace and are not individually reachable requirements.
Cursor-following completion of the intended Invites read is deliberate behavior, not a pagination regression.
Cursor-following completion of the intended Tracks read is deliberate behavior, not a pagination regression.
The Media Agent empty state intentionally retains the device-pairing entry.
Compact navigation remains count-derived for fewer than three resolved destinations; it is not replaced by a route-family exception.
Primitive thresholds use each primitive's real eligible semantic denominator, preserve the closed 24-surface manifest, and do not require meaningless tabs, metrics, or state widgets.

unverified_items: No browser, authenticated E2E, runtime accessibility, deployment, or release evidence was run; those layers are outside this static contract lane.
No unrelated dirty-worktree changes were inspected or altered.
